## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C business combination and TRA execution

- 2018-05-04: Impax / Amneal business combination closes; TRA executed (Exhibit 10.6 to 8-K dated 2018-05-07)
- 2018-05-14: S-1 files form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.5

#### Up-C collapse and TRA amendment

- 2023-11-07: Amendment No. 1 reduces payment rate from 85% to 75% and re-papers PubCo as Amneal NewCo Inc. (former PubCo becomes Amneal Intermediate Inc.); parties stipulate no Change of Control

#### Payment phase

- 2025-12-31: $3.0M paid in 2025; $129.1M unrecorded contingent TRA liability
- 2026-01: $38.8M additional payment

## Explanation

Amneal Pharmaceuticals executed its Tax Receivable Agreement on May 4, 2018 at the closing of the Up-C business combination with Impax Laboratories, originally committing PubCo to pay 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups on future redemptions and exchanges of Amneal LLC units to the pre-combination Amneal Group members. The November 7, 2023 Amendment No. 1, signed alongside an Up-C-collapsing Reorganization, reduced the payment percentage to 75% and re-papered the obligor (the former PubCo became Amneal Intermediate Inc.; Amneal NewCo Inc. became the new PubCo); the parties stipulated that the Reorganization was not a Change of Control, so Section 4.1 acceleration was not triggered. The amendment text itself is not in this directory; the post-amendment terms come from 10-K narrative disclosure and are flagged for manual verification. The contract remains in force at 75% with $129.1M of unrecorded contingent liability at year-end 2025 and a $38.8M payment made in January 2026. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the coverage gap on the November 2023 8-K.
